description: T17 character & idle-animation trial (GDD §19): Mossgrove Legendary + Starhollow Mythic, two views each, binder south idle + east battle set.
animationConstraints: No camera movement and nothing leaves the canvas. No background and no ground shadow. Feet stay on the same fixed baseline. The first and last frame are the base pose.

animations.name: idle
animations.action: Faces the viewer (south) the whole time. Gentle breathing idle in place: the body rises and falls slightly, a soft blink, loops seamlessly.

animations.name: idle
animations.action: Always faces east (right) and never turns. Gentle breathing idle in place: the body rises and falls slightly, loops seamlessly.

animations.name: walk
animations.action: Always faces east (right) and never turns. Walking east in place with a steady cozy gait, no forward travel, loops seamlessly.

animations.name: attack
animations.action: Always faces east (right) and never turns. A quick playful lunge east, then returns to the base pose.

animations.name: hurt
animations.action: Always faces east (right) and never turns. Recoils west from a hit with a flinch, then returns to the base pose.
